statusSummary: Repository is operationally ready with deployment caveats; benchmark conclusions still need broader real-call evidence.

intent.userPrompt: Based on the current state of this repo, is it ready to go and does it properly benchmark the different architectures against each other with a realistic scenario?
intent.description: Evaluate operational readiness and benchmark validity.
scanDiscoveredFacts: Three end-to-end architectures share one concurrent STT orchestration and common output contract.
The default scenario is one 504-second synthetic, dual-channel support call with a 989-word reference and 26 PII annotations.
Summarization output has no reference-based quality metric.
The backend Dockerfile omits data/mock-call-pii-ground-truth.json, preventing built-in upload seeding in the image.

fixes: Copied the PII ground-truth fixture into the backend image and whitelisted it in .dockerignore.
